# `voxel/VoxelModifyCompute.js`

> **Source:** `engine/voxel/VoxelModifyCompute.js`

VoxelModifyCompute.js - GPU Voxel Modification System Now powered by vGPU driver Performs sphere and box removal operations on voxel chunks using compute shaders. Outputs removed voxels for particle spawning.

## Classes

### `class VoxelModifyCompute`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor()` |  |
| `init` | `async init(device)` | Initialize the compute system |
| `removeSphere` | `async removeSphere(chunk, center, radius, innerFactor = 0.6)` | Remove voxels in a sphere using GPU compute |
| `removeBox` | `async removeBox(chunk, min, max)` | Remove voxels in a box using GPU compute |
| `paintSphere` | `async paintSphere(chunk, center, radius, material)` | Paint voxels in a sphere using the GPU compute kernel. |
| `modifySphereGPU` | `async modifySphereGPU(chunk, center, radius, options = {})` | Apply a sphere edit directly to a persistent GPU-resident chunk. This is the interactive path and intentionally does not read the chunk back to CPU memory or produce removed-voxel particle records. |
| `_ensureGPUChunkBuffer` | `_ensureGPUChunkBuffer(chunk)` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Voxel World System

The voxel system provides chunked 3D grids with fast access, mesh generation, and level-of-detail (LOD). Chunks are 32³ by default and stream in/out based on camera position. The mesher generates greedy or marching-cubes geometry depending on material.

**Example: Creating and modifying a voxel world**
```js
import { VoxelWorld } from 'engine/voxel/VoxelWorld.js';
import { VoxelMesher } from 'engine/voxel/VoxelMesher.js';

const world = new VoxelWorld({
  chunkSize: 32,
  loadDistance: 8  // chunks
});

// Set voxel at world position
world.setVoxel(10, 5, 10, {
  type: 'grass',
  color: [0.2, 0.7, 0.1]
});

world.setVoxel(10, 4, 10, { type: 'dirt' });

// Generate mesh for rendering
const mesher = new VoxelMesher(world);
const geometry = mesher.generateChunk(0, 0, 0);

// Raycast to find clicked voxel
const hit = world.raycast(rayOrigin, rayDir, 100);
if (hit) {
  world.setVoxel(hit.x, hit.y, hit.z, null);  // Remove
}
```
